notes: The italic with is given to the adverbial accusative heads of the people under rule 33 rather than marked added.

the lawgiver's portion: the determiner of an English possessive belongs to the possessor's word, so the supplied the goes to מְחֹקֵק and the construct keeps only portion (rule 29's possessive paragraph).
there is the locative adverb שָׁם, not a presentative dummy, so the copula joins the predicate participle סָפוּן (rules 20, 25).
